name: Deferred Payment Loan Calculator
meta_title: Deferred Payment Loan Calculator: Payment After Deferral
meta_description: See what a loan costs when payments are deferred: interest that builds up or is paid during the deferral, the payment afterwards and the total interest.
subtitle: See how a payment deferral changes a loan: the interest that builds up or is paid while payments are on hold, the balance when repayment starts, the monthly payment after that and the extra interest compared with paying from day one.
